how: checks/web_wf2_on_main.py (main's own words and conjugacy test in Z/2*Z/2*Z/2): of the 2,800 products of one to four of the seven moves, all 2,800 carry (abc)^2 to a conjugate of itself or its inverse; 538 carry the three pair classes to themselves, and on H_1 of the even part those give 6 matrices up to sign, all of finite order; 380 have |trace| > 2 and none of them keeps the pair classes; the example (a through b)(b through a)(b through c) is [[-3, 2], [2, -1]]; the two controls and the plant come out as stated. Beyond the note: 144 products have determinant -1 and non-zero trace (132 of them with |trace| at most 2), and none of those keeps the pair classes either, so its remark on determinant -1 changes no verdict. So within these products the all-mirror face admits only the six permutations and the all-half-turn face admits every re-description
note: As the note says, this is a statement about products of length up to four, and the finiteness of the mirror face's steps in full is the standard fact about the thrice-punctured sphere, not shown here.
